name: ball-v1
description: Single-class sports_ball centroid detector for the ESP32-S3 car. Edit priors, budgets and 'fixed' between groups; the search re-reads this file before every planning step.

objective.comment: val_zoom = balls at 6-40 px (the car's working range). val_dev = half of those windows through a fixed simulated ESP32 camera (a proxy until real frames exist; it favours models trained with a similar simulation, so keep its weight modest). val_full = whole COCO frames. val_neg = confuser-rich frames with no balls. ece_cal = calibration error after Platt scaling, which is folded into the exported model: SLAM reads the score as a probability, so a ranking-good but miscalibrated model is penalised. Edit freely: objectives are recomputed from stored metrics, so the whole history is re-scored.

constraints.comment: 3 fps leaves 333 ms per frame for capture, inference, SLAM and control. 200 ms of invoke() is the ceiling until latency_model is calibrated.

latency_model.comment: Add {"mmacs": .., "ms": ..} rows from the firmware's invoke timing, then call tinydet.models.fit_latency(measurements) and paste the result here.

schedule.comment: Each rung also runs a decay branch of optim.decay_frac x rung epochs before it is scored. eta=3: the top third of a rung moves on.

model.pretrained.evidence: Scratch MNV2-0.5 reached F1 0.556 after 600 epochs (0b4db56); pretrained timm only trained to epoch 19 (0.382). Never compared at equal budget.

model.width.evidence: Scratch <=0.35 collapsed under CE in March; 0.75+ doubles MMACs and the arena. Pretrained weights only exist for 0.5 and 1.0.

model.tap.evidence: Edge Impulse FOMO's cut point; +1.7 MMACs; never tested in isolation.

model.head.evidence: dw1 was the head of the best run (0b4db56); dwsep is current; bottleneck argued INT8-friendlier (Doc A); dilated adds a 7x7 receptive field.

data.input_size.evidence: 68% of full-frame val balls are under 4 px at 120. 160 px costs ~1.8x MMACs and a 375 KB arena (likely PSRAM).

model.context.evidence: New. Gives tiny balls scene context; needs RESIZE_NEAREST_NEIGHBOR in the firmware resolver.

target.form.evidence: Heatmap + focal beat one-hot CE in July, but form and loss changed together.

target.sigma.evidence: Effectively fixed at 0.7 so far; 0.7 puts 4-neighbours at 0.36, above the 0.3 threshold.

target.ignore_px.evidence: 3.5 px current; Doc B suggests 5.5 px. Evaluation always uses 3.5, so this only changes training.

loss.alpha.evidence: CenterNet default 2.0; lower keeps logits more compact for INT8.

data.zoom_prob.evidence: Added Oct 14, never trained to completion. Directly targets the 6-32 px balls the car sees.

optim.lr.evidence: 1e-3 and 2e-3 both used; no controlled comparison.

optim.wd.evidence: 1e-4 everywhere; Doc B suggests up to 5e-4 to tame INT8 outliers.

optim.ema.evidence: Implemented in the old notebook but never enabled.

model.freeze.evidence: Early layers frozen for all epochs so far (pretrained runs only).

model.backbone_lr_mult.evidence: Doc A suggests 0.1x on the backbone after warmup.

data.aug.evidence: Generic photometric augmentation. The ESP32 camera model is now separate (data.device_*).

data.device_strength.evidence: Simulated OV2640 pipeline: low-light shot/read noise amplified by AGC, AEC errors with clipping, AWB casts, ISP denoise+sharpen halos, chroma noise, row banding, lens shading, unfiltered DSP downscaling, RGB565. Real gain only measurable on real frames.

data.device_motion.evidence: Car motion: mostly-horizontal motion blur from long indoor exposures, rolling-shutter shear when turning, vibration wobble.

data.device_lens.evidence: Barrel distortion + extra vignetting (+ chromatic aberration for wide). Set to the car's actual lens once known: stock OV2640 ~66 deg = mild; 120-160 deg modules = wide.

data.paste_prob.evidence: Crisp COCO-mask cutouts (balls >= 20 px in their source, training images only) pasted at 6-36 px. Doc B rated it the highest-ROI data change.

data.paste_max.evidence: More pasted balls = more positives per batch, but crowded scenes are unlike the car's view.

data.paste_floor_bias.evidence: From a camera a few cm high, balls sit in the lower part of the frame; >0 also draws contact shadows.

data.bg_source.evidence: Only random backgrounds tried. 'indoor' = COCO images with chairs, couches, tables, beds etc.: closest stand-in for the car's rooms until your own frames go in data.extra_bg_dir.

model.grayscale.evidence: Grayscale only tried with tiny widths and CE. Tennis balls are strongly coloured.

model.norm.evidence: Firmware uses a LUT either way; only INT8 input precision differs. Pretrained stems are re-parameterised exactly.

stages.name: baseline
stages.comment: Reproduce history with today's fixes. 1: the current notebook config with the half-cell offset fixed. 2: the July 0b4db56 recipe (scratch, no TAP, dw1 head, no zoom). 3: seed 1 with the old offset bug, to measure what the fix is worth. eta=1 trains all three to the last rung, which also shows how well 15-epoch scores predict 120-epoch ones.

stages.name: domain
stages.comment: Almost every parameter here changes the data pipeline, so lockstep groups can only share 2 trials (grayscale / norm differ). 24 trials = ~12 data configurations.
